overview: The paper proposes a training-free hallucination detection method for LLMs by reinterpreting the softmax classifier as an Energy-Based Model and tracking 'spilled energy'—the discrepancy between energy values across consecutive generation steps that should theoretically match but empirically correlate with errors—evaluated on synthetic arithmetic and nine real-world benchmarks across multiple LLMs.

modules.name: EBM Softmax Reinterpretation
modules.description: Implement the core theoretical reinterpretation of the LLM softmax classifier as an Energy-Based Model. This includes computing the logit energy (Eℓ) from the selected token's logit and the marginal energy (Em) from the log-sum-exp over the vocabulary logits at each decoding step, establishing the equivalence of partition functions across steps as derived in the paper.

modules.name: Spilled Energy Computation
modules.description: Compute the spilled energy metric (ΔE) as the difference between marginal energy at the next timestep and logit energy at the current timestep, following Equation 8. Also implement the scaled spilled energy (ΔEs = |Em| × ΔE) variant. This module is the central innovation and must handle the cross-timestep energy discrepancy calculation.

modules.name: LLM Logit Extraction Wrapper
modules.description: Build a unified inference wrapper around supported LLMs (LLaMA-3, Mistral, Qwen, Gemma) that runs autoregressive generation and extracts full vocabulary logits at every decoding step. Must support both base and instruction-tuned variants, and return logits in a format suitable for downstream energy computation.

modules.name: Exact Answer Token Localization
modules.description: Implement the exact answer span detection pipeline following Orgad et al. This includes two strategies: (1) heuristic string matching for closed-set tasks (classification, multiple-choice QA), and (2) LLM-based extraction using an auxiliary instruction-tuned model with few-shot prompting for open-ended generation tasks, returning the token index interval [u, w] corresponding to the answer.

modules.name: Pooling Strategies Over Answer Span
modules.description: Implement all pooling methods for aggregating energy scores across the exact answer token span: min-pooling (minimum energy value), max-pooling (maximum energy value), mean-pooling (average energy), last-token pooling (energy of the final answer token), and after-last-token pooling. Min-pooling is the primary strategy used in the paper's best results.

modules.name: Synthetic Arithmetic Data Generator
modules.description: Generate controlled multi-digit arithmetic datasets for evaluating spilled energy. Create correct solutions and incorrect solutions with three difficulty tiers of numerical errors: Easy (large offset in thousands), Medium (offset in hundreds), and Hard (small offset in units). Support configurable digit length and random seed for reproducibility.

modules.name: Hallucination Detection Classifier
modules.description: Implement the training-free hallucination detection logic that applies energy-based thresholds to classify model outputs as correct or incorrect. Given energy scores (spilled, marginal, or logit), compute classification decisions using simple thresholding, and optionally combine metrics for improved detection. No training or probe classifiers are involved.

modules.name: Evaluation Metrics Engine
modules.description: Compute all evaluation metrics used in the paper: Area under the ROC Curve (AuROC) as the primary metric, along with True Positive Rate and False Positive Rate at various thresholds. Support computation of per-dataset metrics, cross-dataset averages, and standard deviations across experimental runs.

modules.name: Real-World Benchmark Pipeline
modules.description: Implement the full evaluation pipeline for the nine real-world benchmarks: HotpotQA, HotpotQA-WC, IMDB, Math, MNLI, Movies, TriviaQA, Winobias, and Winogrande. Handle dataset loading, prompt formatting, response generation, exact answer extraction, energy computation, and metric aggregation for each benchmark.

modules.name: Cross-Dataset Generalization Framework
modules.description: Implement the cross-dataset evaluation protocol where probing classifiers are trained on one dataset and tested on all others, producing confusion matrices of AuROC scores. For the training-free spilled energy method, compute metrics directly across all dataset pairs. Generate the improvement delta matrix comparing spilled energy against probing baselines.

modules.name: Baseline Methods Integration
modules.description: Implement all baseline hallucination detection methods for comparison: (1) Logit confidence (Eℓ) using max-logit over the answer span, (2) p(true) method from Kadavath et al. that prompts the model to self-assess correctness, and (3) Probing classifiers from Orgad et al. that train linear probes on internal activations. Ensure fair comparison with identical evaluation protocols.

modules.name: Temperature Sensitivity Analysis
modules.description: Implement the temperature scaling analysis for spilled energy as derived in Appendix A.2. Compute ΔE under varying temperature τ, analyze the limit cases (τ→∞ uniform distribution, τ→0+ deterministic), and study how temperature perturbs the balance between the two energy terms and accumulates error across sequential generation steps.

modules.name: Visualization and Reporting
modules.description: Generate all paper figures: histograms of spilled energy distributions for correct vs. incorrect answers, ROC curves comparing methods and error difficulties, color-coded comparison visualizations (as in Figure 1), confusion matrices for cross-dataset generalization, and heatmaps of improvement deltas. Also generate LaTeX-formatted result tables matching the paper's Table 1 style.

modules.name: Experiment Configuration Manager
modules.description: Manage all experiment configurations including LLM selection and variant (base vs. instruct), dataset selection, pooling strategy, energy metric type (spilled/marginal/logit), temperature parameter, and random seeds. Support YAML/JSON-based configuration with inheritance for experiment sweeps, and ensure reproducibility through deterministic seeding.

modules.name: Ablation and Sensitivity Study Framework
modules.description: Implement the ablation study on exact answer token localization (with vs. without exact answer extraction, reporting AuROC improvement), pooling strategy comparison across all methods, instruction-tuning impact analysis (base vs. instruct models), and LLM scale analysis (e.g., Gemma 1B vs. 4B). Aggregate results with mean and standard deviation across benchmarks.
